mentions.name: Euclase
mentions.description: Desktop app that acts as a creative harness for generative AI, unifying various image and video generation backends (ComfyUI for local models, APIs for closed ones) into one cohesive interface, with optional integrated agents to pilot the whole workflow. Currently in beta, with onboarding and docs being refined before a wider release.
mentions.problem: Generative image and video tools are fragmented across different backends (local ComfyUI setups and closed-model APIs), and less technical creatives struggle with deep workflows.
mentions.audience: Creative users of generative AI tools, both more technical and less technical
mentions.source_excerpt:
Euclase: http://euclase.ai - the creative harness for generative AI

Unifying all the various image/video gen (comfyui for local, api for closed) in one cohesive desktop app, with integrated agents to pilot the whole thing (if you want).
mentions.author: adam-eclse
